title: Family PREDICATE cannot be used as a model inference premise without a checked family bridge
situation: A two-member family has a PREDICATE count-style claim, but the inference supplies it as a premise without a model-level checked family_bridge.

inputs.missing_premise: A checked family_bridge from an exhibited proved member to a model-level premise.

attempted_conclusion: Use the family PREDICATE claim directly to derive a model conclusion.

expected.reason: The frozen guard rejects a family premise at the DISCHARGE family gate; no checked bridge is supplied.
